联赛新赛季前两轮，每轮为两场常规赛加一场附加赛，两轮共六场赛程。每个战略服赛季开始前，<Highlight>4个赛区组成1个战区</>，在同一战区内进行附加赛匹配，战略服筛选积分在各赛区内分别排名。<Highlight>战略服匹配：</>联赛战区、赛区划分仅用于确定战略服参与资格；资格确定后，系统面向全服务器已获得战略服资格的俱乐部，根据其最终筛选积分与实际综合实力，重新划分战略服并进行档位分组，战略服档位越高，可获得的奖励越丰厚，黄金战略服仅会在最高强度等级的战略服中产生。
附加赛由本轮升降级前的神话组俱乐部参加，包括本轮常规赛结束后应降级的俱乐部；原本将升入神话组的俱乐部本轮不参加。第二场常规赛结束后，<Highlight>同一战区内4个赛区</>的神话组俱乐部，按本轮常规赛最终排名匹配，<Highlight>相同名次的4家俱乐部</>组成一场附加赛。附加赛获得的战略服筛选积分，由<Highlight>本赛区神话组常规赛最终排名</>和<Highlight>本场附加赛名次</>共同决定。
附加赛于每轮第二场常规赛所在周的周日20:45开启，具体日期以赛事赛程为准。附加赛全部结算完成后，再统一执行本轮联赛升降级。
第二轮附加赛结束后，先完成战略服筛选积分结算，再执行本轮联赛升降级；战略服赛区划分延后至下周周一，并在上述结算全部完成后开展，具体执行时刻以实际赛程为准，之后进行势力划分。

The first two rounds of the new league season each consist of two regular matches and one playoff match, for a total of six matches over two rounds. Before the start of each Strategic Server season, <Highlight>4 divisions form 1 theater</>, and playoff matchmaking is conducted within the same theater, with Strategic Server screening points ranked separately within each division. <Highlight>Strategic Server Matchmaking:</> The league theater and division classifications are only used to determine eligibility for the Strategic Server; once eligibility is determined, the system reclassifies and groups clubs across the entire server that have obtained Strategic Server eligibility based on their final screening points and actual overall strength. The higher the Strategic Server tier, the more generous the rewards; Golden Strategic Servers are only generated in the highest intensity tier of Strategic Servers.
Playoffs are attended by Mythical-tier clubs before the promotion/relegation of the current round, including clubs that should be relegated after the current round's regular matches; clubs that were originally going to be promoted to the Mythical tier do not participate in this round. After the second regular match, Mythical-tier clubs from the <Highlight>4 divisions within the same theater</> are matched according to their final ranking in the current round's regular matches, with <Highlight>4 clubs of the same rank</> forming a playoff match. The Strategic Server screening points earned in the playoff match are determined by both the <Highlight>final ranking in the current division's Mythical-tier regular matches</> and the <Highlight>ranking in this playoff match</>.
Playoffs begin at 20:45 on the Sunday of the week of the second regular match of each round; specific dates are subject to the event schedule. After all playoff settlements are completed, the promotion/relegation for the current round will be uniformly executed.
After the second round of playoffs ends, the Strategic Server screening points settlement is completed first, followed by the current round's league promotion/relegation; the Strategic Server division classification is postponed until the following Monday and is carried out after all the above settlements are completed. The specific execution time is subject to the actual schedule, after which faction division will be conducted.

<Highlight>战略服筛选积分</>
仅联赛新赛季前两轮的神话组俱乐部可获得筛选积分；筛选积分与决定对局胜负的局内积分相互独立。第一轮、第二轮使用相同积分表，第二轮不额外加权。
<Highlight>第1场常规赛：</>按四方对局第1至第4名依次获得10、8、6、4分。
<Highlight>第2场常规赛：</>按升降级前本轮最终第1至第8名依次获得40、35、30、25、20、15、10、5分。
<Highlight>第3场附加赛</>
<Highlight>对阵规则：</>第二场常规赛结束后，<Highlight>同一战区内的4个赛区</>，各自神话组本轮常规赛<Highlight>最终排名相同的俱乐部</>组成一场四方附加赛。排名以本轮升降级前为准。
例如，4个赛区的神话组第1名同场对战，第2名同场对战，以此类推，直至第8名。
<Highlight>积分结算：</>附加赛获得的<Highlight>战略服筛选积分</>由两项名次共同决定：<Highlight>本赛区神话组常规赛最终排名</>决定积分档位，<Highlight>本场附加赛第1至第4名</>决定该档位内的具体得分。
<Highlight>附加赛筛选积分明细</>
以下分数均为<Highlight>本场附加赛获得的战略服筛选积分</>。常规赛排名以本轮升降级前为准。
例如：本赛区神话组常规赛<Highlight>第2名</>的俱乐部，在附加赛中获得<Highlight>第3名</>，则本场获得<Highlight>39分</>战略服筛选积分。
<Highlight>本赛区神话组常规赛第1名</>
附加赛：第1名50分，第2名47分，第3名44分，第4名41分。
<Highlight>本赛区神话组常规赛第2名</>
附加赛：第1名45分，第2名42分，第3名39分，第4名36分。
<Highlight>本赛区神话组常规赛第3名</>
附加赛：第1名40分，第2名37分，第3名34分，第4名31分。
<Highlight>本赛区神话组常规赛第4名</>
附加赛：第1名35分，第2名32分，第3名29分，第4名26分。
<Highlight>本赛区神话组常规赛第5名</>
附加赛：第1名30分，第2名27分，第3名24分，第4名21分。
<Highlight>本赛区神话组常规赛第6名</>
附加赛：第1名25分，第2名22分，第3名19分，第4名16分。
<Highlight>本赛区神话组常规赛第7名</>
附加赛：第1名20分，第2名17分，第3名14分，第4名11分。
<Highlight>本赛区神话组常规赛第8名</>
附加赛：第1名15分，第2名12分，第3名9分，第4名6分。
<Highlight>每轮积分</>＝第1场积分＋第2场积分＋附加赛积分；每轮最高100分，两轮合计最高200分。不再叠加原有单场名次积分及第一轮、第二轮最终排名加分。
第二轮附加赛及筛选积分结算完成后，各赛区分别按俱乐部最终筛选总积分排名，本赛区前8名俱乐部晋级四方联赛天启组，并获得战略服参与资格。
<Highlight>同分排序：</>总积分相同时，优先比较本轮常规赛最终排名，排名靠前者优先；本轮常规赛最终排名尚未产生时，同分俱乐部暂不区分先后。
<Highlight>战略服匹配：</>资格确定后，系统面向全服务器已获得战略服资格的俱乐部，根据其最终筛选积分与实际综合实力，重新划分战略服并进行档位分组，战略服档位越高，可获得的奖励越丰厚，黄金战略服仅会在最高强度等级的战略服中产生。
<Highlight>额外神选席位：</>战略服结算时，筛选时的赛区前三名俱乐部可额外获得神选席位：<Highlight>第1名10个，第2名5个，第3名5个</>。

The first two rounds of the new league season each consist of two regular matches and one playoff match, for a total of six matches over two rounds. Before the start of each Strategic Server season, <Highlight>4 divisions form 1 theater</>, and playoff matchmaking is conducted within the same theater, with Strategic Server screening points ranked separately within each division. <Highlight>Strategic Server Matchmaking:</> The league theater and division classifications are only used to determine eligibility for the Strategic Server; once eligibility is determined, the system reclassifies and groups clubs across the entire server that have obtained Strategic Server eligibility based on their final screening points and actual overall strength. The higher the Strategic Server tier, the more generous the rewards.
Playoffs are attended by Mythical-tier clubs before the promotion/relegation of the current round, including clubs that should be relegated after the current round's regular matches; clubs that were originally going to be promoted to the Mythical tier do not participate in this round. After the second regular match, Mythical-tier clubs from the <Highlight>4 divisions within the same theater</> are matched according to their final ranking in the current round's regular matches, with <Highlight>4 clubs of the same rank</> forming a playoff match. The Strategic Server screening points earned in the playoff match are determined by both the <Highlight>final ranking in the current division's Mythical-tier regular matches</> and the <Highlight>ranking in this playoff match</>.
Playoffs begin at 20:45 on the Sunday of the week of the second regular match of each round; specific dates are subject to the event schedule. After all playoff settlements are completed, the promotion/relegation for the current round will be uniformly executed.
<Highlight>Strategic Server Screening Points</>
Only Mythical-tier clubs in the first two rounds of the new league season can earn screening points; screening points are independent of the in-game points that determine the outcome of a match. The first and second rounds use the same points table, and the second round is not additionally weighted.
<Highlight>1st Regular Match:</> 10, 8, 6, and 4 points are awarded to the 1st to 4th place finishers in the Four-Way match, respectively.
<Highlight>2nd Regular Match:</> 40, 35, 30, 25, 20, 15, 10, and 5 points are awarded to the 1st to 8th place finishers in the current round before promotion/relegation, respectively.
<Highlight>3rd Playoff Match</>
<Highlight>Matchup Rules:</> After the second regular match, <Highlight>4 divisions within the same theater</> each have their Mythical-tier clubs with the <Highlight>same final ranking in the current round's regular matches</> form a four-way playoff match. Rankings are based on the status before the current round's promotion/relegation.
For example, the 1st place Mythical-tier clubs from 4 divisions compete in the same match, the 2nd place clubs in another, and so on, down to the 8th place.
<Highlight>Points Settlement:</> The <Highlight>Strategic Server screening points</> earned in the playoff match are determined by two rankings: the <Highlight>final ranking in the current division's Mythical-tier regular matches</> determines the points tier, and the <Highlight>1st to 4th place in this playoff match</> determines the specific score within that tier.
<Highlight>Playoff Screening Points Details</>
All scores below are the <Highlight>Strategic Server screening points earned in this playoff match</>. Regular match rankings are based on the status before the current round's promotion/relegation.
For example: A club that is <Highlight>2nd place</> in its division's Mythical-tier regular matches and earns <Highlight>3rd place</> in the playoff match will receive <Highlight>39 points</> in Strategic Server screening points.
<Highlight>1st Place in Division Mythical-tier Regular Matches</>
Playoff: 1st place 50 points, 2nd place 47 points, 3rd place 44 points, 4th place 41 points.
<Highlight>2nd Place in Division Mythical-tier Regular Matches</>
Playoff: 1st place 45 points, 2nd place 42 points, 3rd place 39 points, 4th place 36 points.
<Highlight>3rd Place in Division Mythical-tier Regular Matches</>
Playoff: 1st place 40 points, 2nd place 37 points, 3rd place 34 points, 4th place 31 points.
<Highlight>4th Place in Division Mythical-tier Regular Matches</>
Playoff: 1st place 35 points, 2nd place 32 points, 3rd place 29 points, 4th place 26 points.
<Highlight>5th Place in Division Mythical-tier Regular Matches</>
Playoff: 1st place 30 points, 2nd place 27 points, 3rd place 24 points, 4th place 21 points.
<Highlight>6th Place in Division Mythical-tier Regular Matches</>
Playoff: 1st place 25 points, 2nd place 22 points, 3rd place 19 points, 4th place 16 points.
<Highlight>7th Place in Division Mythical-tier Regular Matches</>
Playoff: 1st place 20 points, 2nd place 17 points, 3rd place 14 points, 4th place 11 points.
<Highlight>8th Place in Division Mythical-tier Regular Matches</>
Playoff: 1st place 15 points, 2nd place 12 points, 9 points for 3rd place, 6 points for 4th place.
<Highlight>Points per Round</> = 1st match points + 2nd match points + playoff points; maximum 100 points per round, total maximum 200 points for two rounds. The original single-match ranking points and the final ranking bonus points for the first and second rounds are no longer added.
After the second round of playoffs and screening points settlement are completed, each division ranks clubs based on their final total screening points. The top 8 clubs in each division advance to the Four-Way League Apocalypse tier and obtain Strategic Server eligibility.
<Highlight>Tie-breaking:</> When total points are the same, the final ranking of the current round's regular matches is compared first, with the higher rank taking priority; if the final ranking of the current round's regular matches has not yet been determined, tied clubs are not distinguished for the time being.
<Highlight>Strategic Server Matchmaking:</> Once eligibility is determined, the system reclassifies and groups clubs across the entire server that have obtained Strategic Server eligibility based on their final screening points and actual overall strength. The higher the Strategic Server tier, the more generous the rewards; Golden Strategic Servers are only generated in the highest intensity tier of Strategic Servers.
<Highlight>Extra God-Chosen Seats:</> When the Strategic Server is settled, the top three clubs in the division during screening can receive extra God-Chosen seats: <Highlight>1st place 10, 2nd place 5, 3rd place 5</>.
